# CamScanner MCP & HD Auto-Scanner

> Free, open-source (MIT) Python document scanner that turns phone photos of paper into clean multi-page 300 DPI PDFs using OpenCV (perspective fix, shadow removal, paper whitening, sharpening), plus ready-made configuration for connecting AI agents (Claude Desktop, Kilo CLI, Cursor) to the CamScanner MCP endpoint. Independent project, not affiliated with CamScanner / INTSIG.

Key facts: local engine runs offline on your CPU; Python 3.9+; dependencies opencv-python, pillow, numpy, pypdf; main script scripts/batch_scanner.py; remote MCP endpoint https://ai-tools.camscanner.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, CamScanner's own service).
